SRC-025:R001.text: Release publication must bind every release-owned path to the exact reviewed blob content hash or reviewed deletion from an immutable plan manifest: after write-tree the owned tree entries must equal the frozen reviewed identity and any same-path restage after the ship gate must refuse before commit or publication.

SRC-025:R002.text: Crew pre-ship certification must validate the frozen applicable role set semantically: declared probe against the role contract, ALWAYS role never NOT_APPLICABLE, source_head and source_tree_fingerprint both matching the release frozen source identity, and non-empty structurally valid evidence for every applicable role; malformed or mismatched authority refuses instead of certifying.

SRC-025:R003.text: Applicability filesystem enumeration must surface every unreadable included subtree as explicit uncertainty so relevant negative verdicts fail closed to APPLICABLE; unreadable descendants must never silently count as proof of absence while excluded-directory errors stay outside the observation.

SRC-025:R004.text: GUI applicability probing must classify constant __import__(toolkit) and importlib.import_module(toolkit) forms including aliased imports as GUI evidence, and unclassifiable import-like toolkit expressions must yield INDETERMINATE, while comments, docstrings and plain strings stay non-evidence.

SRC-025:R005.text: Audit enqueue idempotency must be bound to durable producer + producer_operation_id authority: equal body digest alone must never synthesize operation identity or adopt an existing layer; allocator loss with existing audit history must recover only from durable operation records or fail closed with a bounded recoverable refusal while genuine first-use allocation stays fresh and spent layer numbers are never reused.

SRC-025:R006.text: A COMMITTED audit enqueue whose physical layer is missing succeeds idempotently only when exact same-layer same-digest downstream capture authority proves delivery: no binding requires restore or a recoverable refusal, same path with different digest is conflict, same digest on a different path proves nothing, corrupt binding fails closed.
